ops.rationale: The highlights follow the revised text: the general claim is scoped to the two binary tasks, 'most robust' gives way to the two measured stress-test results with the federation named as simulated, and the terms are those of the manuscript.
ops.new_text:
- Representation mattered more than the clustering algorithm on two binary ECG tasks.
- ECGFounder clustered SR vs AF best (ARI 0.885), hand-crafted features 0.711.
- Raw flattening and a convolutional autoencoder clustered at chance (ARI ~0).
- Silhouette scored a one-cluster solution at 0.81 while its ARI was 0.
- Hand-crafted features led at 9:1 imbalance and kept 92% of ARI in simulated skew.
